rows.grounds: compound of vṛddhi and aṣṭa indicating a limit of eight increments
compound of mātra and paryanta expressing extent up to a limit
compound of vṛddhi and hāni denoting augmentation and diminution
optative prescribing application within the stated range

items.question: What limit governs the application of increase and decrease in prescribed measures?
premises: Prescribed measures admit adjustment by increase and decrease.
The permissible adjustment extends up to eight measures.
Such adjustment is to be applied in practice.
items.inference: Therefore one should apply increase and decrease up to a limit of eight measures.
uncertainties: Whether mātra refers to a specific unit of length, quantity, or a general measure is not explicit in this verse.
items.plain_english: One should apply increase and decrease up to the limit of eight measures.
